widgets.title: Saw the "please update" page (sessions), by platform
widgets.query: index=dino_usage screen=update {{app}} | timechart dc(session) by platform

widgets.title: Pressed the update button, by platform
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=tap detail="update:update" {{app}} | timechart count by platform

widgets.title: On the update page: sessions and button presses, by platform and version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage screen=update {{app}} | stats dc(session) as sessions, count(eval(detail="update:update")) as presses by platform, version

widgets.title: Android launches, by version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened platform=android | timechart count by version

widgets.title: iOS launches, by version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened platform=ios | timechart count by version

widgets.title: Windows launches, by version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened platform=windows | timechart count by version

widgets.title: Launches per version, last 24 hours, by platform
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened {{app}} | chart count over version by platform
